name: @dsh-toolset/preference-analysis

scripts.test:coverage: rm -rf ../tmp/cov-preference-analysis && mkdir -p ../tmp/cov-preference-analysis && NODE_V8_COVERAGE=../tmp/cov-preference-analysis node --experimental-transform-types --test 'tests/*.test.ts' 'tests/integration/*.test.ts' && node ../dev/coverage/report.mjs tmp/cov-preference-analysis tmp/cov-preference-analysis/report.json
